skipSemantics: May-skip, not must-skip: a listed test that runs and passes on a machine where its precondition holds is green. Matching is exact on the pre-'(' portion of the TRX result testName (xunit theory rows serialize with arguments, e.g. Class.Method(x: 1)); a name with no parens matches whole. Anchor is the TRX result list, never Counters arithmetic.
admissionRule: allowedSkips is not a quarantine list. A test may be listed only when its precondition is a property of the machine or OS that cannot be satisfied by configuration during a contract run, and its change names the machine class where it executes. Two named PERMANENT BANS apply: (1) CcpClient.Tests.DataRootOverrideTests.DefaultSettingsPath_EnvUnset_IsThePlatformDefault must never be allowed to skip because a process-wide CCP_DATA_ROOT override makes the floor vacuous; (2) CcpClient.Tests.ChaosTunnelLoopbackTests.Logging_RouteClassesOnly_NeverFilenameOrQuery must be fixed at the source, never quarantined.
bumpRule: Bump total only in the same commit as the test change that moves the count, with the reason recorded here. Never widen, disable, or special-case a check to make a step pass. Adding a name to allowedSkips requires the admission rule above and the machine class where it executes.
lastMovedBy: +2 unit, +1 headless: THREE SMALL ROWS, AND THE TOAST ANSWER WAS REPRODUCED BEFORE IT WAS FIXED. Driven headless at the shell's own size, three distinct notices stacked and COVERED BOTH LAUNCH BUTTONS by name. The answer is QUEUE, NOT CAP, showing the NEWEST: nothing is dropped, and a waiting notice takes the screen when the one above it goes. Newest rather than oldest because a refusal is tied to the press that raised it - queued behind an unread export result it would arrive attached to nothing, which is upstream's own recorded defect. A displaced TIMED toast keeps its clock, because an 8-second announcement must not resurface stale; a dismiss-only one has no clock and always gets its turn. THE CAP MUTATION REDS BY DOING EXACTLY THE DAMAGE THE ROW PREDICTED - capping at two drops the export result. Two facts asserting visible stacking were rewritten and neither claim weakened: 'dismissing one never takes away an unread message' is now proved by the next one ARRIVING. THE DPI MANIFEST IS DECLARED, measured rather than reasoned, and three measurements changed the answer's shape: with the manifest in force Avalonia's own call returns ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED and becomes a no-op; through the muxer the manifest does NOT apply, so BOTH are load-bearing; and no startup phase reads display geometry yet, making this a declaration rather than a bug fix. The test host was deliberately NOT made aware - it would move the coordinate space under five real-window suites other lanes own and buy no extra proof, since each is a self-consistent round trip. The real risk was discharged headed: Avalonia did not throw when its call was refused. THE CENSUS ENTRY was stale three ways, and the lane's mechanical proposal is the valuable part - extend the citation tool to check a QUOTED STRING beside a citation appears inside the cited range, which alone would have caught this and is the gap all five doc-rot cases fell through. CcpClient.Tests 3323 to 3325, CcpClient.HeadlessTests 267 to 268.
